svg.title: Kartik Gaikwad (sid2428): pixel arcade profile
svg.desc: Pixel-art portrait of Kartik Gaikwad, a third-year E&TC student at PICT Pune who builds backend and full-stack software. A self-playing mini game shows a character squashing bugs while tests pass, the ground is made of his stack (Java, Spring Boot, Python, FastAPI, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker), and a quiz box asks visitors guess-the-answer questions about his work.
